marks.name: Mk II
marks.title: Studio voice fix and error details
marks.notes:
Fixed: Studio voice (AI) failed on Windows with 'Something went wrong while processing this file'. Two causes, both fixed: the AI model's settings file could not be read on Windows, and a library it imports was missing from the app.
New: when a repair fails, Show details gives the stage it stopped at, your settings and the full technical error, with Copy details and Open error log buttons. The same details are saved to errors.log.

marks.name: Mk III
marks.title: Scrub the spectrum and change the tone after repairing
marks.notes:
New: drag across the Before or After picture to scrub, with a moving playhead. Switch Picture to Spectrum to see the sound as colours. Before and After stay at the same position, so you can switch between them while listening.
New: Tone. Change Warmth, Clarity, Brightness and Air (or use Warmer / Brighter / Clearer) after the repair. You hear it straight away, the spectrum follows it, and saving applies it to the repaired file and matches the loudness again, without repairing the recording a second time.
